Orthopedic radiograph interpretation: 3

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A trainee describes a tibial fracture as translated laterally but does not state the reference fragment. The supervisor asks for standard terminology to avoid ambiguity. Which convention should guide the description of fragment displacement?

  1. Include adjacent joints when indicated
  2. Assess extension into the joint surface
  3. Inspect soft tissues as well as bone
  4. Describe distal-fragment position relative to the proximal fragment
  5. Obtain adequate orthogonal views
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Describe distal-fragment position relative to the proximal fragment

Standard descriptions use the distal fragment relative to the proximal fragment.

Understanding the options

Describe distal-fragment position relative to the proximal fragment
Standard descriptions use the distal fragment relative to the proximal fragment.
Obtain adequate orthogonal views
A fracture or displacement can be missed or mischaracterized on a single projection. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Include adjacent joints when indicated
Shaft injuries may be accompanied by proximal or distal joint disruption. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Assess extension into the joint surface
Articular involvement affects congruity, prognosis and treatment planning. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Inspect soft tissues as well as bone
Gas, swelling, effusion and foreign bodies can provide important injury clues. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
